reviews.title: Better off spending full retail price
reviews.comment: When the box came and looked like it had been ran over; I didn’t have very high hopes. I was not surprised to find the audio was severely distorted, muffled, and sharp, the mic quality I was told in chat was horrible, and the volume knob did not work. I get that it’s a refurb, but for only $50 less than retail I assumed it would at least be usable.
reviews.author: Carley

reviews.title: Worth it
reviews.comment: Easy setup with Logitech G-Hub setup. Great sound, comfortable, easy to use. Microphone can detach - sound quality is fantastic, battery life is amazing. Happy purchase.
